name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Sensor

pin_roles.name: ECHO
pin_roles.description: Echo pulse returned to the controller.

expected_behavior: A controller trigger pulse starts a ranging cycle and the module returns an echo pulse whose width represents time of flight.
safe_measurement_notes: The ECHO output may reach the module supply voltage; use a verified divider or level shifter before a 3.3 V input.
Catalog context does not replace measured evidence or a board-specific datasheet.
